title: Magic Product Review - Hung Drawn & Quartered Reimagined
description:
Joel Anthony has updated his Hung Drawn and Quartered release with a new imagination that includes more routines and effects than the first release. This is a solid presentation of a classic card to impossible location with variations that allow you to do it with an everyday object, your key ring. Watch the review to see if this is right for you. You can find this at any Murphy's Magic retailer like Penguin Magic, or Alakazam Magic.

Thanks for watching. If you could take a moment to hit that like and subscribe button it would be greatly appreciated.
